picks.title: Airstrikes have paused and talks are pressing forward. But can the US and Iran take the off-ramp?
picks.summary: After weeks of US strikes deep inside Iran and Houthi retaliation against Saudi Arabia, the Trump administration has paused further escalation — reportedly out of concern that continued strikes would exhaust dwindling US Patriot interceptor stocks in the region — while diplomatic talks pick up pace to find an off-ramp from the conflict.
flags: Ceasefire/pause is informal and could break down quickly; sourcing on US motives is anonymous

picks.title: German police hunt suspect in Berlin Pride van-ramming attack that left 1 dead and 16 injured
picks.summary: A vehicle plowed into a crowd at a Berlin Pride event, killing one person and injuring roughly 16 others; German police are hunting a suspect in what is being treated as a targeted attack on the LGBTQ+ event, and the mayor has vowed unity in response.
flags: Attacker's identity/motive unconfirmed at time of writing

picks.title: Biden ghostwriter tapes to be released
picks.summary: The Justice Department is set to release recordings of interviews Joe Biden gave to a ghostwriter, material that has become a flashpoint in ongoing political sparring between Biden allies and the Trump administration.
flags: Politically charged release; framing will likely diverge sharply along partisan lines

picks.title: Protesters again block access to ICE surveillance hub in Williston, prompting arrests
picks.summary: Police arrested 13 people Friday morning after protesters again blocked access to ICE's National Criminal Analysis and Targeting Center in Williston, part of an ongoing series of demonstrations against the facility.

picks.title: "Resultado de muchos sacrificios": Puerto Rico se consolida como la principal potencia del polo acuático masculino en la región
picks.origTitle: "Resultado de muchos sacrificios": Puerto Rico se consolida como la principal potencia del polo acuático masculino en la región
picks.summary: Puerto Rico's men's water polo team has cemented itself as the region's top power after repeating as Central American and Caribbean Games gold medalists in Santo Domingo, a decade-long build the athletes credit to sustained sacrifice.

picks.title: SpaceX eyes tower catch for next Starship after auspicious end to 13th flight
picks.summary: After a clean 13th Starship flight, SpaceX is now considering attempting to catch the booster back at the launch tower on the next mission.

picks.title: Paramount/WBD merger delayed for months as states' lawsuit moves toward trial
picks.summary: Paramount has agreed to delay its merger with Warner Bros. Discovery for months after losing a court bid, as a multi-state antitrust lawsuit heads toward trial; New York's AG called the delay a critical win.

picks.title: DeepSeek pauses fundraise after comments on compute gap to US leaked
picks.summary: A leaked transcript of an investor meeting reportedly shows DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng discussing a widening compute gap versus US AI labs; DeepSeek has since paused its fundraising round.
flags: Leaked/unofficial transcript — authenticity not independently verified
